offering_description.value: Sells a self-service software platform that lets advertisers and agencies buy and manage digital advertising programmatically across video, streaming TV, display, audio and mobile. Customers pay a fee based on the advertising spend they run through the platform.

primary_products.value: demand-side advertising software platform; audience data tools; ad measurement and analytics tools

primary_services.value: programmatic campaign management; campaign optimization; ad performance reporting

customer_segment.value: B2B: advertising agencies, brands, marketers and in-house trading desks

end_markets.value: advertising; media and entertainment; retail; consumer goods; travel

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: percentage fee on advertising spend bought through the platform

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: connects advertisers to ad inventory sellers and takes in campaign data, sold to agencies and brands

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America and other regions worldwide

specialization.value: niche specialist: one core line: programmatic advertising buying software and related data and measurement tools

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to large agencies, brands and holding companies; online: self-service platform used by advertisers and agencies to run campaigns

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: data privacy and consumer protection rules such as GDPR, CCPA and cookie and tracking restrictions
